study_role: bounded operational-trigger continuation after a transparent native-fog spatial near-miss

near_miss_amendment.passed_context: All nine other native checks passed, including both-route clear < light < heavy means and sample severity Spearman 0.360324; unchanged local-glare gates passed on validation and held-out routes.
near_miss_amendment.allowed_interpretation: The checkpoint may be tested as a whole-front-camera operational evidence-loss trigger.
near_miss_amendment.prohibited_interpretation: The checkpoint is not validated as a semantically correct or generally reliable spatial uncertainty map.

frozen_online_signal.adapter_input: ORION EVAViT position-level feature grid [1,6,1024,40,40] after the same model-input corruption
frozen_online_signal.component_aggregation: mean of persistent-direction, persistent-magnitude, and transient-inconsistency scores

execution_order.purpose: measure detection timing, false positives, camera selectivity, and recovery without changing vehicle controls

execution_order.execution_gate: run only if the trace gate passes

controlled_stop_success: eligible terminal record, 100% route completion, zero pedestrian/vehicle/layout collisions, no blocked or timeout infraction, and score_composed strictly greater than the transient-off score 50

stop_rules.trace_gate_fails: Do not run learned control; treat the checkpoint only as an offline anomaly diagnostic.
stop_rules.learned_control_fails: Stop without constant, shuffled, route, or seed expansion; the learned signal/control interface has not reproduced the oracle mechanism.
stop_rules.learned_control_passes: Record a one-route exploratory learned mechanism success; do not yet claim spatial-UQ validity or paper-level generalization.

uniform_termination_rules.low_speed_fast_screen: cancel and mark diagnostic-only if absolute ego speed remains below 0.25 m/s for at least 8 consecutive simulation seconds
uniform_termination_rules.runtime_no_progress: cancel and mark environment-error if both trace and agent log remain unchanged for at least 8 wall-clock minutes

prohibited_expansion: additional seed before the bounded learned controlled-stop result
